summary: Cache-aside with TTL: miss fills from the in-process store, hit logs cache_hit. Redis ping failed (REDIS_DOWN True) so redirect still 307 via memory fallback. PATCH invalidates; post-patch Location is the new URL. Abuse twist: 8x307 then 429.
evidence: REDIS_DOWN True LOG_REDIS_DOWN_FALLBACK True. First GET /r/{code} 307 https://example.com/cached (cache_miss+cache_set); second 307 same Location (cache_hit).
PATCH 200 long_url https://example.org/new; POST_PATCH_REDIRECT 307 LOCATION https://example.org/new STALE_AVOIDED True LOG_CACHE_INVALIDATE True. Did not docker-stop Redis — it was already down.

ABUSE_REDIRECT_COUNTS {307: 8, 429: 2} implements constraints_twist abuse_spike. Caching is not free: invalidation, TTL, and Redis-down fallback are extra failure modes. Command: module06_cache_verify.py
